iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

GENERICMESSAGE_INGRESS
       Raised when a message is received by the generic message filter.

DESCRIPTION
       This event is raised when a message is received by the generic message filter.

Examples
	when GENERICMESSAGE_INGRESS {
	    GENERICMESSAGE::message src us
	    GENERICMESSAGE::message dst them
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
